### PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Dividends for Its Preferred Shares


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s201.q4cdn.com/230652881/files/doc_news/2026/11/PMT-4Q26-Preferred-Dividend-Declaration-v3.pdf)


WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (NYSE: PMT) announced today that its Board of Trustees has declared cash dividends for the fourth quarter of 2026 on its 8.125% Series A Preferred Shares (NYSE: PMT PRA), its 8.000% Series B Preferred Shares (NYSE: PMT PRB) and its 6.750% Series C Preferred Shares (NYSE: PMT PRC).

**About PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust**


PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust is a mortgage real estate investment trust (REIT) that invests primarily in residential mortgage loans and mortgage-related assets. PMT is externally managed by PNMAC Capital Management, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. (NYSE: PFSI). Additional information about PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust is available at[pmt.pennymac.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpmt.pennymac.com%2F&esheet=54639036&newsitemid=20261110502044&lan=en-US&anchor=pmt.pennymac.com&index=1&md5=b4333af2c515609b8434362ee3c6a418) .
